name: 5-Methoxy-7,N,N-trimethyltryptamine
summary: 2% at 5-HT2A (vs 5-HT), and weaker activity at 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C.

pharmacology.text: 5-Methoxy-7,N,N-trimethyltryptamine (5-MeO-7,N,N-TMT, 5-MeO-7-TMT), also known as 7-Me-5-MeO-DMT, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a partial agonist at the 5-HT2 serotonin receptors, with an EC50 of 63.9 nM and an efficacy of 66.2% at 5-HT2A (vs 5-HT), and weaker activity at 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C.

summaryZh: 5-甲氧基-7,N,N-三甲基色胺，是一種色胺衍生物，可作為5-HT2血清素受體的激動劑。
summaryZhHans: 5-甲氧基-7,N,N-三甲基色胺，是一种色胺衍生物，可作为5-HT2血清素受体的激动剂。

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is 5-MeO-DMT with an extra methyl group at the 7 position of the indole ring, a spot few tryptamines carry anything at.
fact.zh: 它是在5-MeO-DMT吲哚環的第7位再加一個甲基，而這個位置在色胺類中很少有取代基。
fact.zhHans: 它是在5-MeO-DMT吲哚环的第7位再加一个甲基，而这个位置在色胺类中很少有取代基。
